name: kb_538_Normalized

schema.description: LoadBalancerIngress represents the status of a load-balancer ingress point: traffic intended for the service should be sent to an ingress point.

hostname.description: Hostname is set for load-balancer ingress points that are DNS based (typically AWS load-balancers)

ip.description: IP is set for load-balancer ingress points that are IP based (typically GCE or OpenStack load-balancers)

instructions: Please update the hostname to lb-1234.us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com (updated).
